summary: Test your brain and iq. Answer the questions in this family game & word trivia.
description:
Sequel to the fan-favorite word trivia quiz game Popular Words: Family Game is here! Being your own tv show game with amazing new game modes and even more fun trivia questions!

Enhance your trivia quiz game experience with Popular Words 2. It has a unique design and it is an addictive, fun quiz game like its predecessor Popular Words. This brain teasing game invites you to a great trivia game experience. Test your general knowledge, vocabulary, intelligence, and ingenuity with a relaxing design and gameplay while improving your IQ, memory, concentration, attention and logic. Guessing words has never been this fun!

If you are a word game fan, try this challenge, take the quizzes, and discover Popular Words 2. Enjoy the highly addictive quiz game mode with new competitive tv show elements! Try to score high points by not only guessing the very popular answers to short everyday questions in life, but also in correct order. Enjoy this fun quiz game with your friends and family. Hours and hours of fun are guaranteed with this free and addictive trivia quiz game! Your awareness of your daily routine will also increase. You will be aware of what people say generally and become a master of game show games.

If you like headbands games, people games and guess the word games you will enjoy this fun word trivia game too. Get everyone's heads up in your family and ready to play this engaging family game of guessing words to fill in the blanks.

Popular Words 2, TV shows like implementation, will be your favorite in family and friends. Feud in the family is inevitable when the time comes answering questions. “Fifty Fifty” will make it easier to select the correct answer by reducing the options into two answers. When you have a wrong guess you can use “Extra Move” to compensate for it. If you are sure you are really good then use “Double Points” to double the points you earn from the answers and advance in ranks fastly. You will always have the “Remove Answer” option to get rid of excessive answers in this free trivia game.

Get famous by rising up in the ladder of popularity. Feel like a true trivia celebrity and a talk show host. Start from nobody and reach the level of Legend! Every correct answer and extra game modes grant you popularity points to help in this tricky trivia journey. Fun quiz show game blends with a true word search experience empowered with millions of quizzes and trivia challenges. Guess the answers and become a star and prevent feud in your family!

FAST FAME

Can you guess quickly what the other players picked? The words will seem very easy, but the answers are tricky and be aware of jeopardy. Quiz up the questions in a row to get higher points in this trivia pursuit. Are you careful enough to keep your turn in this puzzle brain game? Each level win will increase your points multiplier as you take higher risks in higher trivia levels.

WHEEL OF FUN

Spin the wheel, answer the questions from the five different categories, collect the points, and advance in the leaderboard. Geography, History, Sports, Science, and Movies have their own rankings. Show yourself in which category you are outstanding in this free quiz game. Your trivia and popular culture trove will be enlarged massively by playing our trivia questions.

FEATURES

- Hundreds of questions, thousands of word challenges

- Daily gift coins for free hints

- Three different modes to entertain yourself

- Questions from Geography, History, Sports, Science, Movies

- Simple & easy to play. Relaxing music and gameplay

- Leaderboards to compete with others.

- Brain test for your general knowledge

- Completely free to play word trivia. Guess up now!

- Offline gameplay.

Gather your family and friends to play this word party game and recreate the popular TV shows in your house. Make the social gatherings exciting again!
